characters.name: Askeladden
characters.prompt: A humble Norwegian young man from the 1400-1850 era, dressed in slightly ragged peasant clothes with simple leather boots. He has a thoughtful, kind expression, light brown hair, and a modest posture.

characters.name: Dukken i Gresset
characters.prompt: Initially very small, dressed in delicate, ornate Norwegian folk attire with tiny silver details, and later transforms into a radiant grown woman in a flowing old-style dress. She is graceful, with long golden hair.

characters.name: The King
characters.prompt: An older, regal figure in an early Norwegian royal robe. He wears a modest crown, has a stern yet fair expression, and is accompanied by subtle symbols of royalty, like a scepter or embroidered cloak.

characters.name: The Older Princes
characters.prompt: Eleven brothers each wearing matching but slightly soiled finery, carrying swords. They have prideful expressions, yet their travel-worn clothes and smudged faces show their recent misadventures.

characters.name: The Havmand (Sea Man)
characters.prompt: A mysterious figure emerging from water, with a rugged, otherworldly appearance. He has a noble bearing, faint luminescence, and an air of magic surrounding him.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: A richly detailed illustration set in old Norway between 1400 and 1850. The scene includes an open, grassy landscape near a simple wooden castle. Askeladden stands beside his horse, wearing ragged yet hopeful attire. Opposite him is a tiny, elegantly dressed Dukken i Gresset, seated in a shiny silver spoon pulled by two white mice. Surrounding them are hints of the King’s presence, distant older princes on horseback, and a calm body of water where the Havmand emerges. Earthy colors, traditional Norwegian patterns, and a soft, glowing light convey a sense of wonder and folklore.
modernMainImagePrompt: An urban or semi-rural Norwegian scene in present-day. Askeladden wears casual modern clothes and sneakers, standing at the edge of a park. A miniature Dukken i Gresset rides in a small rolling cart pulled by remote-controlled toy mice. In the background, you see a modern royal family figure (the King) on a decorated platform, with the older princes dressed in business suits looking on. A modern fountain represents the Havmand’s domain. Bright colors and contemporary details reflect a playful adaptation of this folktale in today’s world.
childMainImagePrompt: A bright, cheerful illustration in a fairytale style for young children. Show Askeladden as a friendly boy wearing simple storybook clothes, gently smiling at a tiny, kind-eyed Dukken i Gresset who sits in a magical silver spoon pulled by two white mice with big, cute eyes. Include a friendly-looking King in soft royal robes, and the older brothers in funny, messy outfits. The water with a gentle Havmand peeking out adds a whimsical element. Use soft, rounded shapes and a warm color palette suitable for a 5-year-old audience.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Tegn ei fargerik scene med Askeladden i gammeldagse klær mens han står ved siden av den vesle Dukken i Gresset. Hun sitter i ei sølvskje trukket av hvite mus. Kongen står foran et norsk slott i bakgrunnen, og de elleve brødrene er litt slitte og sjalu. Havmannen dukker opp fra vannet langt bak. Fokus på en magisk, eventyrpreget stemning i norsk natur.
englishMainImagePrompt: A detailed fairytale-style illustration capturing the essence of old Norway’s countryside. Place Askeladden in modest, rustic clothes, alongside a tiny Dukken i Gresset in a silver spoon drawn by two white mice. Show the King’s distant castle and the eleven older princes in slightly tattered finery. Include the Havmand emerging from a nearby pond, lending a magical aura. The overall atmosphere should be reminiscent of a classic European folktale set between the 1400s and 1850, with soft, idyllic lighting and authentic Norwegian backdrop.
